title: Member Appeals Program Enrollment: One Open Program per Member
content:
A member may hold no more than 1 Member Appeals Program that is not closed at any one time, and that program is tied to the member's plan enrollment.

**Condition for opening.** A new appeal program may be opened for a member only when none of that member's appeal programs is pending effective, active, or in runout. Whether this condition is met is read from the statuses of the member's existing appeal programs in the system records.

## Status of the member's existing programs

| Status of an existing appeal program of the same member | Effect on opening a new appeal program |
|---|---|
| Pending effective | Bars the new program |
| Active | Bars the new program |
| Runout | Bars the new program |
| Closed | Does not bar the new program under this condition |

Each member is checked separately. A program held by a different member does not count toward this member's limit.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- **Earlier program closed.** A member's earlier Member Appeals Program has passed through runout and is now closed. That closed program does not stand in the way of a new program.
- **Earlier program still in runout.** A member's program entered runout when plan coverage ended, and it is still in runout. A second appeal program may not be opened for that member while the first one remains in runout.
- **Future-dated program.** A member's program is pending effective because the plan enrollment starts later. That program also bars a second open program.
